description: Refugee ID card generic naming — supersedes UNHCR/Verify+ branded strings for these 4 keys. Supersedes the in-review TC-1483 fill for REGISTRATION.HEADER.TITLE.VERIFYPLUS (that patch used the old branded text; this one replaces it with generic wording). Machine-translated draft for the 10 non-English languages — needs native-speaker/vendor review before import to any environment.
